de: Haben Sie schon Pläne für das Wochenende?
en: Do you have any plans for the weekend yet?
note: Often asked on Thursday or Friday.
situation: Weather, weekend and free time small talk

de: Was machen Sie gern in Ihrer Freizeit?
en: What do you like to do in your free time?
note: Slightly more personal; good when getting to know someone.
situation: Weather, weekend and free time small talk

de: Bei dem Wetter bleibe ich lieber zu Hause.
en: In this weather I'd rather stay at home.

en: Unfortunately the weekend was way too short.

de: Mal sehen, ich habe noch nichts geplant.
en: We'll see, I haven't planned anything yet.

de: Wenn das Wetter mitspielt, machen wir einen Ausflug.
en: If the weather cooperates, we'll go on a day trip.
